matches.rationale: GT1 concerns the unified actor loss definition in Section 4.2 and Appendix I.2, specifically the inclusion of extra terms (L_div, L_dyn) and inconsistent treatment of L_BC. Neither finding addresses this actor loss formulation; pred_1 and pred_2 both point to different equations in Appendix I.1 (equations 4 and 5 about value functions), not the actor objective.

GT2 concerns inconsistent critic update formulas across SAC-N, CQL, and EDAC implementations (specifically mean vs min aggregation in the EDAC update_actor pseudocode). Neither finding addresses this; both findings point to value function equations in Appendix I.1, not the critic/actor update implementations in the algorithm pseudocode blocks.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Points to a legitimate issue with equation (4) in Appendix I.1 missing case conditions, but this defect is not in the ground truth.
Points to a legitimate issue with undefined variable \tilde{a}_{t+1} in equation (5), but this defect is not in the ground truth.
